line: One dot doubles every ten years: 128 after seventy, 6.02 without compounding, and the last ten years are worth all the rest.
line_cn: 一个点每十年翻一倍：七十年后是 128，不复利只有 6.02，最后十年抵得上之前的全部。

camera.move: Build on a locked frame; push in slowly once a composition is complete
Move the whole group, not the camera, when the meaning changes: a slope swings f

camera.expresses: push into a colour band until it fills the frame, cut, pull out of the same colour in the next scene.
a fast lateral move to a scene beside this one, long construction lines passing to carry the speed.
the pieces of a scene fall out of frame, its construction lines stay and re-form as the next scene's grid.

camera.move: Every scene uses a different entry; a whole film never sits on one fixed frame

transitions: Through a shape: push into a colour band until it fills the frame, cut, pull out of the same colour in the next scene.
Grid match cut: the pieces of a scene fall out of frame, its construction lines stay and re-form as the next scene's grid.
labels: Latin and numbers: a geometric sans (e.g. Jost, OFL, variable). Key word or number 800 with tight tracking (−2 to −6); the light companion line 300 with wide tracking (+12 to +18); reading lines 500; small labels 600–700 caps with +3 to +6 tracking.
Chinese: a sans (e.g. Noto Sans SC, OFL, subset to the characters used), 700, tracking +2 to +4, ≥ 34 px on screen (after camera scale). One Chinese line per scene at most.
Type joins the shapes: a letter can be a shape (the O of a word is the protagonist dot); a number sits on the line it measures or in the field it names.

How type arrives: letters rise out of a slot on their baseline, one block at a time; labels slide out from under an edge (clipped by it); reading lines reveal left to right. Never fades, never typewriter.
motion: Roll: pure rolling, angular speed = distance ÷ radius, so the path is a true cycloid. A growing ball's phase is integrated along the path.
Grow: at each step a ring lands on the outside ("thunk"), newest outermost, all rings tangent at the protagonist's core.
Land: squares slide along the grid and lock with a small overshoot; slopes swing up about one corner; dots drop and squash once.
Sweep: a turning thing leaves a secondary-colour wedge; the same angle sweeps more area at a larger radius.

native_moves.name: The snowball
native_moves.does: a protagonist dot rolls up a field-colour slope, gains a ring at each step of growth, draws its arcs, and ends as a disc that breaks the frame.

native_moves.name: The ruler
native_moves.does: the slope swings flat; ticks rise from it, each to the height the growing thing had reached, so the grid draws the curve.

native_moves.name: Cut and tangent
native_moves.does: a compass circles part of a shape, it slides out leaving a hole, two tangents tie the hole to the piece, an equals sign drops between them.

native_moves.name: The ghost
native_moves.does: a finished shape drains to its outline; a second run grows inside it, and the outline is the comparison.

native_moves.name: The grid sets the type
native_moves.does: lines left by the last scene become baselines and cap lines; numbers rise into them; operators are built from shapes (+ is two crossed bars, = is two bars, a point is a ball).

native_moves.name: Swept area
native_moves.does: a lever or a hand turns and leaves a wedge.

score.note: tuned percussion and plucks on a steady grid
